raw_display.outcome: Apply compiled local formats while retaining unparsed entered raw. Track only effective formatters and explicit renderers; read native property changes and explicit input events without adopting the last Form-written projection. RuleContext.rowId remains null.
raw_display.remaining: Local before/after callbacks, unbound-key observation, partial binding and dynamic discovery remain required.

focus_validation.outcome: Preserve focused editable raw/caret, invalid entered text and readonly projection. Use detached raw-filled probes only where local text is projected; preserve native custom validity, effective disabled state, group/file semantics and business/cross-field raw checks. Parsers affect validation and do not rewrite local read().
focus_validation.remaining: No inverse format, implicit business normalization or complete shared rule/default equivalence is claimed.

native_reset.outcome: Observe distinct effective native owners: native control form ownership and ancestor forms of static fields, including currently supported ancestor and form= controls. Wait for native default action and final cancellation, reconcile affected controls, clear only affected field errors and refresh dependent displays. Retain static raw even for a static-only Form. Flush completed pending resets before public local operations; an in-dispatch read observes pre-reset values. Coalesce work in one owned task and preserve unrelated owners.
native_reset.remaining: Native reset follows current DOM defaults. Ancestor-owned radio groups retain existing FORM_RADIO_OWNER restrictions. Rows-backed native reset does not implicitly write business data; complete legacy live InitialData/unbind semantics remain open.

lifecycle.outcome: Reject local formatted static targets that are editable/error regions or contain interactive, field or error content before ownership. Guard local formatter/renderer target raw, generation and disposal before writes, bound recursive refresh, restore local values, exact authored image src attributes and authored children on constructor failure, and release listeners/Select/root ownership. Dispose formatted controls and images to their latest entered raw value/src and restore other authored display children without changing Rows-backed disposal.
lifecycle.remaining: Application side effects are not transactional; wider shared/global row lifecycle equivalence remains required.

migration.outcome: Use existing Rows for full received raw records and unbound keys. Explicit Rows operations own business changes and revert. Received status-insert appendState/replaceState checkpoints retain inserted defaults on revert; ordinary add-plus-revert removes that inserted row. Document native defaults separately from explicit live application checkpoints and exercise a real CVC search Form.
migration.remaining: All v1 Forms own datasets. This local display cache does not replace that legacy data owner or close all Form workflows.

installed.outcome: Use one exact tarball in isolated JavaScript/TypeScript and Chromium/Firefox/WebKit/actual Windows Chrome/Edge, exercising existing public Form local raw/reset APIs, Rows migration recipes and cleanup. Retain complete fresh three-engine coverage and original performance budgets.
installed.remaining: No npm publication or release tag. Actual macOS/iOS Safari remains excluded; available WebKit remains mandatory.
